purpose: Test one new deterministic structural candidate, multires_ensemble, that fuses full-gallery discriminative logits from three temporal resolutions (10ms/25ms/50ms) under the frozen production_recipe training contract. Rationale: experiment 48 production_recipe reaches only 13% Task3 recall@32, which caps Hungarian final OCF; 10ms counts (25 time bins over the 250ms window) have never been tested in this project, and cross-resolution fusion is a new information source rather than a reranker or weight search. Development reuse is neither pristine validation nor a Kaggle result.
scope: Create files only under test/53_multiresolution_ensemble. Do not modify src or other experiments. Experiment 48 code is read-only and supplies prepare_task2, prepare_task3, OcfPairCache, evaluate_logits, aggregate_rows, select_epoch and find_aggregate unchanged. Do not read experiment 49, 50, 51 or 52 outputs. No production change and no Kaggle submission.

data.row_preparation: Experiment 48 prepare_task2 and prepare_task3 unchanged, applied separately to each view's block set; per-session normalizers are fitted from that view's train_trials only.

task2.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task2', seed=42, validation_session=s) for s in session1, session2, session3, in that order

task3.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task3', seed=s) for s in 20261126 and 20261127, in that order

arm.name: multires_ensemble
arm.fusion_weighting: equal arithmetic mean of per-view row z-scores; fixed, never fitted

model_and_training.per_view_configuration: Experiment 48 production_recipe unchanged: hidden=512, dropout mice1=0.2/mice2=0.35, label_smoothing=0.05, weight_decay=0.001, AdamW, learning_rate=3e-4, batch_size=256, apply_log=False, gradient_clip_norm=5.0, training_seed=42, max_epochs=20.
model_and_training.input: Experiment 48 per-session log1p+z-score normalization of the view's raw counts.
model_and_training.epoch_selection: For every view and task independently, select the macro assigned_final_ocf best epoch using experiment 48 select_epoch unchanged. This mirrors production's own rule; no cross-view epoch coupling and no per-fold selection.
model_and_training.consistency_check: The 25ms view must reproduce experiment 48 production_recipe block-level metrics (absolute tolerance 1e-5) for every task/fold/mouse/epoch; otherwise abort before fusion and report the observed difference.

fusion.inputs: Each view's validation logits at that view's selected macro epoch.
fusion.normalization: Row-wise z-score per view: (x - row_mean) / max(row_std, 1e-6).
fusion.combination: Arithmetic mean of the three z-scored logit matrices.
fusion.no_fusion: No top-32 restriction, reranking, temperature, learned weights, or candidate mixing.
fusion.evaluation: Experiment 48 evaluate_logits and src.retrieval.unique_assignment on the full 256x2748 fused matrix.

evaluation.aggregation: Experiment 48 corrected aggregate_rows: block rows -> mouse_fold -> mouse/fold/macro.
evaluation.ocf_scale: Native official 0-100 OCF; the +3 gate is an absolute assigned_final_ocf difference.

reference48.comparator: production_recipe at its own already-selected macro epoch independently in Task2 and Task3.
reference48.integrity: Before cache/CUDA access, validate both hashes, selection linkage, preregistration linkage, subset, selected epochs and row counts.

advancement_gate.comparison: multires_ensemble minus experiment 48 production_recipe at production's own selected epoch, independently within each task.
advancement_gate.per_mouse: Both mouse-level assigned_final_ocf deltas must be >=0 in each task.
advancement_gate.folds: Fold-level assigned_final_ocf deltas averaged over two mice must be nonnegative for at least 2/3 Task2 folds and 2/2 Task3 folds.
advancement_gate.outcome: All per-task gates must pass for overall advance=true. Otherwise stop with no alternate view set, fusion weight, epoch rule or hyperparameter search.

audits.per_fit: Record view, task, fold, mouse, train row counts, feature dimension, and every evaluation-epoch metric.
audits.isolation: Changing held-out features must not change any view's normalizer, training rows, or fitted model; per-view normalizers are fitted only on that view's train_trials.
audits.fusion_smoke: Synthetic checks must confirm row z-score, equal-weight fusion, full-candidate axis, and that a single-view fusion equals that view's own scores.
audits.gate_smoke: Exercise positive, macro-negative, mouse-negative and fold-negative selection cases.

outputs.overwrite_policy: Refuse --run if either output already exists.

prohibited: Task2 session4 validation or final evaluation
hidden test labels or sample-ID/target alignment
validation labels for normalization, training, epoch selection inside a fold, or fusion weights
view-set, fusion-weight, temperature, rank, dropout or other hyperparameter search
